content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-s07-6u6mmpze/report.rdl

Change the 'Total Hours' label to read 'Total Operating Hours' and italicise it.

{"valid": true, "issues": [{"severity": "warning", "rule": "unused-data-source", "location": "DataSource[Name='LegacySQL']", "message": "DataSource 'LegacySQL' has no DataSet that references it", "suggestion": "remove the unused DataSource or wire a DataSet to it"}, {"severity": "warning", "rule": "unused-data-source", "location": "DataSource[Name='ScratchPowerQuery']", "message": "DataSource 'ScratchPowerQuery' has no DataSet that references it", "suggestion": "remove the unused DataSource or wire a DataSet to it"}, {"severity": "warning", "rule": "date-param-as-string", "location": "ReportParameter[Name='DateFrom']", "message": "parameter 'DateFrom' looks date-like but is typed as String; string equality with a Date column will mismatch at runtime", "suggestion": "set DataType to DateTime"}, {"severity": "warning", "rule": "date-param-as-string", "location": "ReportParameter[Name='DateTo']", "message": "parameter 'DateTo' looks date-like but is typed as String; string equality with a Date column will mismatch at runtime", "suggestion": "set DataType to DateTime"}, {"severity": "warning", "rule": "dataset-fields-out-of-sync", "location": "DataSet[Name='DataSet1']/Fields/Field[Name='Utilization']", "message": "<Field Name='Utilization'> is declared but the DAX <CommandText> does not appear to return that column", "suggestion": "rewrite the dataset query (update_dataset_query) or remove the orphan field (remove_dataset_field)"}], "xsd_used": true}

I changed the 'Total Hours' label (textbox `TotalHoursLabel`) to read "Total Operating Hours" and set it to italic. A read-back confirms the new text and the italic style.

The file still passes validation. The warnings it reports were already there and I didn't touch them: two unused data sources (LegacySQL, ScratchPowerQuery), the DateFrom and DateTo parameters typed as String, and a Utilization field that the dataset query may not return.
